# Comment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Comment`](gmeow-Comment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Comment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

A note that replies to an annotation or another comment — a threaded discussion node. Every [`Comment`](gmeow-Comment.md) has exactly one [`commentParent`](../properties/gmeow-commentParent.md) (the annotation or comment being replied to). The transitive [`hasReply`](../properties/gmeow-hasReply.md) reaches all descendants in the thread. A note without a parent is a plain [`Note`](gmeow-Note.md), not a [`Comment`](gmeow-Comment.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Note`](gmeow-Note.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Comment`](gmeow-Comment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Note`](gmeow-Note.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
